title: Potassium chloride suicide plan

tellings.quote: And I bought potassium chloride, one of the three chemicals in the lethal injection.

plain: In 2008, in Britain, Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he broke into NASA computers, bought potassium chloride, one of the three chemicals used in lethal injections, planning to take his own life. McKinnon tells this himself, about the pressure he was under at the time. It shows how much the case against him weighed on him.
